title: 겹받침 1: 값[갑], 여덟[여덜] — 앞 글자로 읽기
objective: You can read words with ㄳ, ㄵ, ㄼ, or ㅄ as the final consonant using the sound of the first letter.
summary: Learn to read the double final consonants ㄳ, ㄵ, ㄼ, and ㅄ using only the first letter.

task.title: Read and choose sounds
task.line: Say each word aloud first. Then pick or write the sound or spelling that each item asks for.

words.meaning: eight (used to count things and hours)

words.exampleMeaning: The price is a bit high.

words.meaning: to not have, to not be there
to be wide, to be spacious

letters.as: Like k in 'book', cut short. Skip the ㅅ.
Like n in 'pan'. Before a vowel, ㅈ moves over: 앉아요 [안자요].
Like l in 'feel'. Skip the ㅂ.
Like p in 'cup', with lips closed. Before a vowel: 없어요 [업써요].

exercises: Write the final sound you hear (ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ, or ㅂ): ① 몫 ② 얹다 ③ 얇다
Choose the right pronunciation: ① 없고 → [억꼬] / [업꼬] ② 넓지 → [널찌] / [넙찌] ③ 앉고 → [앋꼬] / [안꼬]
Find the word whose final sound is different from the other two: ① 값 / 밥 / 넋 ② 여덟 / 얇다 / 앉다 ③ 몫 / 국 / 없다
The sound and the spelling are different. Choose the right spelling: ① 사과 (여덜 / 여덟) 개 주세요. ② 이 가방 (갑 / 값)이 얼마예요? ③ 의자에 (앉으세요 / 안즈세요).
answers: ① ㄱ [목] ② ㄴ [언따] ③ ㄹ [얄따]
① 넋 (넋 [넉] ends in ㄱ; 값 [갑] and 밥 end in ㅂ) ② 앉다 (앉다 [안따] ends in ㄴ; 여덟 [여덜] and 얇다 [얄따] end in ㄹ) ③ 없다 (없다 [업따] ends in ㅂ; 몫 [목] and 국 end in ㄱ)
① 여덟 ② 값 ③ 앉으세요
